subject: ddl: fix flaky test TestCancel & fix panic when we failed to get job in delivery2Worker (#53887)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on DDL scheduler/job-table refresh and metadata/state-machine handling. The only runtime-behavior change in DDL is in jobScheduler.delivery2Worker: it now refreshes jobs using the captured jobID (not job.ID) and avoids dereferencing/logging fields on a possibly-nil job when GetJobByID fails, preventing a retry-loop nil panic while keeping existing retry/exit behavior. Added failpoints are test-oriented; no new correctness/data-consistency/concurrency risks at Blocker/High severity were found in the touched DDL path.
